If you are as passionate about helping those in need as you are about growing your career, consider AltaMed. The Linkage to Care Coordinator II is responsible for the seamless enrollment into medical care and ancillary services of all newly diagnosed HIV and Hepatitis C patients and patients transferring care to AltaMed. At AEG, we believe great patient experiences begin with great teams. As a Patient Care Coordinator you are responsible not only for front desk operations, but also for supporting patient flow, schedule optimization, and seamless coordination across the care team.

The ability to anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and proactively manage the daily schedule helps ensure an efficient, high-quality experience for every patient.

Greet patients, customers, and vendors in a friendly, professional, and welcoming manner; serve as the primary point of contact for patient interactions.
Answer telephone calls, respond to inquiries, and manage email or digital communications in a timely and professional manner.
Schedule patient appointments while supporting provider schedule optimization, including managing cancellations, reschedules, and same-day fill opportunities.
Execute appointment confirmation and reminder processes to reduce no-show rates and ensure patients are prepared for their visit.
Verify insurance eligibility and patient demographics prior to appointments; accurately enter and maintain complete information in EMR.
Maintain a clear understanding of insurance plans and effectively communicate coverage, benefits, and patient financial responsibility.
Prepare patient charts and required documentation in advance of visits to support efficient patient flow.
Collect and document all charges, co-pays, and payments into EMR; allocate balances appropriately and support claim preparation and submission.
Run reports and review accounts to ensure all charges are billed, filed, and up to date.
Monitor daily patient flow and provider schedules to identify bottlenecks, delays, or overlaps; communicate and adjust as needed to support efficient patient flow.
Proactively communicate with patients regarding wait times, delays, and next steps to maintain a positive experience.
Coordinate with clinical and optical teams to ensure smooth patient transitions and continuity of care throughout the visit.
Support patient retention efforts through follow-up, recall, and reactivation outreach, including annual and medically necessary appointments.
Assist in maintaining an organized, clean, and patient-ready front office environment.
Perform other duties as needed and as assigned by the Practice Manager, Assistant Practice Manager and/or Optometrist.

Requirements

High school diploma or equivalent.
Basic computer literacy and ability to learn practice management systems (EMR).
Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
Strong communication skills (verbal and written) with a focus on patient-centered service.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively across teams.
Ability to proactively identify issues and contribute to solutions in a fast-paced environment.
Must be able to maintain patient and practice confidentiality.

jobs.title: Medical Case Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role & Team

The Medical Case Manager facilitates and coordinates continuity of medical care for Disney Cruise Line Crew Members and Guests as directed by shipboard medical providers. The role serves as a primary point of contact for individuals who are medically disembarked from a vessel or evacuated from a Disney Island destination and maintains timely, accurate case records through resolution. The Medical Case Manager also reviews pre-employment and returning Crew Member medical examinations, coordinates medical clearance requirements, and supports safe return-to-work or return-to-vessel planning. The position collaborates with shipboard providers, Marine Claims, external providers, and shoreside operational partners while identifying opportunities to improve case management and medical review workflows.

The Medical Case Manager will report to the Manager, Case Management & Public Health for Disney Cruise Line.

The position is on-site and located shoreside based out of the Health Services Building near Epcot.

What You Will Do/Responsibilities

Manage continuity of care for medically disembarked Crew Members and Guests, including coordination of appointments, treatment plans, medical records, transportation, and follow-up through case resolution.
Coordinate medical evacuations from vessels and Disney Island destinations and provide appropriate shoreside follow-up.
Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential documentation in the electronic medical record and applicable case management tracking systems.
Monitor outstanding case requirements, obtain required medical records or specialist reports, and communicate case status and next steps to appropriate stakeholders.
Coordinate return-to-work, return-to-vessel, and fit-for-duty review activities in collaboration with treating providers and designated Disney Cruise Line medical leadership.
Review pre-employment medical examinations for new and returning Crew Members to determine whether required components are complete and applicable medical standards are met.
Contact Crew Members, recruiting partners, clinics, or providers regarding missing or incomplete medical examination documentation.
Escalate medical examinations or clearance cases requiring physician review in accordance with established protocols.
Collaborate with the Chief Physician and other designated medical leaders on complex medical clearance and case management decisions.
Oversee and support development of external provider networks to facilitate safe, timely, and appropriate medical services across cruise itineraries.
Plan and coordinate medical care and transportation needs with shoreside partners for various cruise line itineraries.
Provide training and guidance related to electronic medical record incident reporting and case documentation workflows.
Identify and support process improvements related to medical clearance, pre-employment medical examination review, case tracking, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
Use available technology and workflow tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, follow-up, and service delivery.
Uphold responsibilities established within the Safety Management System for assigned areas of responsibility.
Provide customer-focused support, exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and work proactively across a high-volume, time-sensitive environment.
Participate in an on-call rotation, including overnight, weekend, and holiday coverage, and travel occasionally as required.

Basic Qualifications

Current, unrestricted Florida Registered Nurse license required.
Valid Florida driver license.
Experience coordinating complex medical cases across multiple providers and stakeholders.
Strong clinical judgment, critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills within the role’s scope and established protocols.
Excellent organization, prioritization, and time-management skills with the ability to manage concurrent cases and meet deadlines.
High level of accuracy and attention to detail in medical review, documentation, and follow-up.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience with electronic medical records and digital case-management workflows.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Teams, and SharePoint.
Ability to learn new technology and use workflow tools effectively.
Ability to handle confidential medical and employment-related information appropriately.
Self-directed, resourceful, collaborative, and service-oriented approach.

Preferred Qualifications

1+ year of relevant case management experience.
Experience in the maritime or cruise industry.
Experience in occupational health, utilization review, disability management, travel health, remote healthcare, or maritime healthcare.
Experience with medical clearance, fit-for-duty, return-to-work, or pre-employment medical examination review.
Experience supporting process improvement or workflow optimization initiatives.
Certified Case Manager credential or other applicable case management certification.

Education

Bachelor of Science in Nursing from an accredited program - Required
Master of Science in Nursing – Preferred

The hiring range for this position in Lake Buena Vista, FL is $83,000-$111,200 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

Vice President of Finance

DIRECT REPORTS:
No

LOCATION:
Must be located in or near Kansas City, KS, Las Vegas, NV, Denver, CO, Bismarck, ND, Dallas, TX, Houston, TX, San Antonio, TX, Omaha, NE, Phoenix, AZ, or Salt Lake City, UT.

Job Summary

Want to take the lead on a fuel program that directly impacts fleet efficiency, cost savings, and operational performance? We’re looking for a Fuel Program Manager to help shape and optimize our company-wide fuel strategy. This role will oversee everything from fuel purchasing and planning to fuel card controls, fraud prevention, reporting, and data analysis — turning insights into strategies that improve efficiency and reduce costs across our fleet.

If you enjoy digging into data, finding smarter ways to operate, and making a measurable impact, this could be a great fit.

This position has the potential to be remote.

Essential Job Duties

Manage and oversee all aspects of the company’s fuel management program.
Develop and maintain fuel management policies, procedures, internal controls, and fraud prevention measures.
Manage fuel purchasing, fueling plans, and fuel utilization by location and route.
Manage the issuance, tracking, monitoring, and cancellation of fuel cards.
Monitor and audit fuel transactions to identify errors, misuse, irregularities, and potential fraud.
Prepare and analyze regular reports on fuel costs, utilization, consumption, and efficiency.
Reconcile fuel transactions and ensure accuracy of all fuel-related expenses.
Create and maintain fuel management dashboards and KPIs.
Regularly assess fleet and truck-specific fuel efficiency and make recommendations for improvement.
Analyze fuel pricing, usage, and operational data to identify cost-saving opportunities.
Develop financial models and recommendations for fuel tanks, fueling infrastructure, and other fuel-related investments.
Monitor fuel budgets, forecasts, and expenditures and identify significant variances.
Work with Operations, Fleet, Accounting, and Finance to resolve fuel-related issues and improve processes.
Provide regular fuel analysis and strategic recommendations to the Vice President of Finance and senior management.
Prioritize and manage multiple fuel management projects and initiatives.
Occasional travel is required.
Other duties as assigned.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Skills And Knowledge

Well-developed interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with diverse personalities and departments.
Must possess excellent organizational, communication (written and verbal), analytical, and decision-making skills.
Strong knowledge of fuel management, fleet operations, fuel purchasing, and cost control.
Strong understanding of internal controls, transaction auditing, and fraud prevention.
Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with proficiency in Excel and data visualization tools.
Experience with fuel management, fleet management, or ERP systems preferred.
Ability to analyze trends and develop data-driven recommendations.
Ability to independently manage the company’s comprehensive fuel management program.
Knowledge of fuel industry trends, pricing, and fleet fuel efficiency practices preferred.

Work Conditions

Generally, a standard office environment.
The ability to work irregular hours when necessary.
Occasional travel to company locations or fueling facilities may be required.
